title: Reranker technical workload calibration
finding: Reranking with effective `fetch_k=500` degrades technical retrieval (hybrid Coverage@20 0.738 → 0.540, ~19× mean latency). Intended pool-size sweep is inconclusive because labelled pools 50/200/500 all resolved to effective `fetch_k=500`; recommend disabling reranking for technical/hybrid workloads.
